name: Scoriaceous-Strath
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a tidally locked hemisphere emerge like the bones of the planet.

The air carries ammonia and old snow, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.

The colonists of the monolithic structures of unknown origin kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Whoever controls titanium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
